job.purpose: Routed ranks-p6 (CLOSED TT+90.16/FF+18.67/DRC0) SS -269.51: the one-cycle loop lc -> (lc!=0) -> pick2 ranks -> ll_ptr select -> grant -> lc+av-tk. Structural cut: each lane's request is its own register lc_nz (== lc!=0 every cycle) updated by a 2-level AND-OR of the registered count decode and (av_r, ll_tk); the 7-bit add/sub and zero tests leave the loop. No cycle, same outline/pins/SDC.
